searchText: **Mascot needed for Glamsterdam upgrade ** 🐜🦫🐝🦩🐹🐙🐻‍❄️🐩 Vote for your favorite https://ethereum-magicians.org/t/mascot-needed-for-glamsterdam-upgrade/26008 Hey everyone, there was some funding "coming out of nowhere" (Bankr, we'll see how reliable this will be, but some promising start) for feelyourprotocol.org, so I'll be able to continue to build stuff here! 😊 Yesterday I've set up a protocol exploration around Amsterdam **EIP-8024**, showing the behavior of the new DUPN/SWAPN/EXCHANGE opcodes and also include some gimmicks like **immediate calculators** and stuff: https://feelyourprotocol.org/eip-8024-stack-opcodes-dupn-swapn-exchange I would really and honestly value some feedback especially of you (everyone reading here!) guys what kind of tooling/experimentation would additionally be helpful around Glamsterdam EIPs and what EIP to tackle next! 🙏 (for contact you'll find out how!). **ACDC <t:1781175600:R>** Agenda: <https://github.com/ethereum/pm/issues/2113> Stream: <https://youtube.com/watch?v=dAC7lgFLivY> Zoom: <https://ethereumfoundation.zoom.us/j/81973476602?pwd=L8ob6xqxvsaDcFe92c6Us5NxCupqpH.1> cc <@&1417820113981145228> 🙂 Thank you for trying out the new time for the ACDC call! If we decide to more permanently change the call time, we'll announce it in a future call BEFORE making the change. So ACDC #181 will occur at the usual scheduled time. I appreciate trying the alternate time! ACDC 11UTC

excerpts.author: holgerd77
excerpts.content:
Hey everyone, there was some funding "coming out of nowhere" (Bankr, we'll see how reliable this will be, but some promising start) for feelyourprotocol.org, so I'll be able to continue to build stuff here! 😊

Yesterday I've set up a protocol exploration around Amsterdam **EIP-8024**, showing the behavior of the new DUPN/SWAPN/EXCHANGE opcodes and also include some gimmicks like **immediate calculators** and stuff:
https://feelyourprotocol.org/eip-8024-stack-opcodes-dupn-swapn-exchange

I would really and honestly value some feedback especially of you (everyone reading here!) guys what kind of tooling/experimentation would additionally be helpful around Glamsterdam EIPs and what EIP to tackle next! 🙏 (for contact you'll find out how!).
